run_densepose_evaluation: run densepose COCO evaluation by initializing denseposeCOCOeval with ground truth and detection COCO objects then calling evaluate accumulate and summarize
compute_ogps_iou: compute the OGPS IoU between densepose detections and ground truth using computeOgps with UV coordinates and SMPL mesh geodesic distances
find_closest_mesh_vertices: find the closest SMPL mesh vertices for predicted and ground truth UV points using findAllClosestVerts across 24 body parts
compute_geodesic_distances: compute pairwise geodesic distances between ground truth and predicted mesh vertices using getDistances with the precomputed Pdist_matrix lookup table
configure_evaluation_params: configure COCO evaluation parameters by creating a Params object with iouType segm bbox keypoints or uv to set IoU thresholds recall thresholds and max detections
